195796.overview:
Goldorak (also known as UFO Robot Grendizer, Grandizer, Ufo Robot Grendizer Raids, and Goldrake), is a Japanese manga and animated television series created by Go Nagai in 1975.

This is an original digital table created by ROM for Future Pinball, and later ported to Visual Pinball X by Javier1515.

470945.overview:
UB40 is an English reggae band, formed in December 1978 in Birmingham, England. The band has had more than 50 singles in the UK Singles Chart and has also achieved considerable international success.

This is a mod of Gottlieb's 1978 "Count-Down" for Visual Pinball X.

471261.overview: Homebrew table for Visual Pinball X based on the classic first person shooter.
